tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Get the public profile of an X/Twitter account: display name, bio, follower/following counts, tweet count, verification, etc.

username.description: X/Twitter handle without the @ (provide one of username / user_id / user_link).

user_link.description: Full URL of the X/Twitter profile.

tools.name: get_user_info_batch
tools.description: Get public profiles for multiple X/Twitter accounts in one request. Provide a list of usernames and/or user_ids.

user_ids.description: Array of numeric X/Twitter user IDs.

tools.name: get_followers

username.description: X/Twitter handle without the @ (provide one of username / user_id / user_link).

user_link.description: Full URL of the X/Twitter profile.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
